target: the two-state design cannot afford false positives — an unanchored 'drop the' fires inside 'backdrop theme'. Text signals match on word boundaries; path signals (containing /) stay substrings.
cmd:
printf -- "---
id: 1
title: t
status: queued
profile: standard
depends_on:
---

" > fp.md; printf -- "- **objective**: update the backdrop theme and eavesdrop the logs
" >> fp.md; printf -- "- **input_paths**: a.sh
- **output_spec**: nicer
" >> fp.md; fp=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible fp.md 2>/dev/null); real=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible "$FIXTURES/irreversible/drop_column.md" 2>/dev/null); path=$("$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/lib/tracker.sh" irreversible "$FIXTURES/irreversible/migration_path.md" 2>/dev/null); printf '{"falsePositive":"%s","real":"%s","path":"%s"}' "$fp" "$real" "$path"
